SELECT source_period, source_file, source_payload_sha256, chunk_key,
   COUNT(*) AS row_count, MAX(COALESCE(out_of_order_rows,0)) AS out_of_order_rows,
   COUNTIF(pit_eligible) AS pit_eligible_count
FROM `aidy-signals.aidy_analytics_test.research_backfill_manifest`
WHERE source='histdata'
GROUP BY source_period, source_file, source_payload_sha256, chunk_key
ORDER BY source_period

SELECT _backfill_run_id, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM `aidy-signals.aidy_analytics_test._stage_research_candles`

   COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT research_identity) AS identity_count,
   MIN(open_time_utc) AS first_open, MAX(open_time_utc) AS last_open,
   COUNTIF(pit_eligible) AS pit_eligible_count
FROM `aidy-signals.aidy_analytics_test.research_candles`
WHERE source='histdata'
GROUP BY source_file, source_payload_sha256, chunk_key, timeframe
ORDER BY source_file, source_payload_sha256, timeframe

recent_jobs.query:
SELECT creation_time, job_id, job_type, statement_type, state,
   error_result, destination_table, total_bytes_processed,
   dml_statistics.inserted_row_count AS inserted_row_count,
   dml_statistics.updated_row_count AS updated_row_count,
   dml_statistics.deleted_row_count AS deleted_row_count,
   query
FROM `aidy-signals.region-eu`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_PROJECT
WHERE creation_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 3 HOUR)
  AND user_email = @service_email
ORDER BY creation_time DESC
LIMIT 120
